name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Brace your core, set your shoulders back, and push your hips straight backward with a flat spine.
Guide the dumbbells close to your legs until your hamstrings feel taut and you can still keep your back neutral.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.
tips: Keep the slight bend in your knees constant rather than squatting down.
Keep the dumbbells close to your shins and stop lowering before your lower back rounds.
